A FEW BALLS TO FIND YOUR FEET

Meet the ball.

Watch the bowler’s hand, read the bounce, and bring the bat to the ball. The bat is regulation width. Start at half speed if you need more time.

Move your mousePosition the bat across the crease and up or down. The small guide marks the middle of the blade.Left click + moveHold, then drag to drive the bat through the ball. More mouse travel gives more reach; faster travel adds bat speed. Release to reset.Right clickHold for a soft-handed block. Move the blade to meet the ball. Move it aside to leave the delivery.A / D · W / STurn the face left / right and add loft. Q / E rotates the blade for cuts and pulls. C resets all three angles.Space · PBowl the next ball · pause or resume. Settings take effect on the next delivery.

Touch: drag to position and play. For the full experience, use a mouse and keyboard. Pace and movement use a physical approximation; this is an early simulation, not a validated coaching instrument.
